title: GroundedAnswerCard
description: The answer contract for every support-bot reply. Reuses the Sherlock-Scout answer-card shape (sherlock-search/docs/evidence-answer-contract.md): an answer that ships MUST carry supporting evidence refs, at least one citation, a confidence at or above the floor, and a receipt (ProofArtifact) from the estate spine (ADR-0001 AC-1).

evidence.description: Evidence refs (anchor/evidence ids) that support the answer. Empty => ungrounded => rejected.

citations.description: Source refs shown to the client. Empty => ungrounded => rejected.

confidence.description: Must be at or above the grounding floor (0.6). Below the floor the bot must abstain via missingInfo, not answer.

receipt.description: The ProofArtifact emitted on the receipt spine for this answer (WO-B). Required and non-null: an answer without a receipt is not an answer.
